COMPARABILITY: at fixed text, fertility, compression_ratio, and total_tokens contain one degree of freedom: on the first 20 eligible WikiText passages, fertility=T/1400 and compression_ratio=T/7192, giving Pearson r=1.000000 with total_tokens over all 61 current outputs. vocab_size is a direct architecture column, while the small-corpus occupancy ceiling makes vocab_utilization predominantly 1/V (rho=-0.985612).

CODE/BOUNDARY: fertility divides by max(1,total_words). A three-space input for which a tokenizer emitted 3 tokens had total_words=0 yet returned fertility=3.000000 instead of NA/error; this lies outside the papers' nonempty-document estimand and therefore does not downgrade implementation fidelity on that domain.

CODE/ITERATION: lines 84-86 materialize an entire iterable before applying num_samples. A counting iterator with 10000 rows was advanced all 10000 times even though the effective limit was 20; an unbounded stream would not terminate.

CODE/VALIDATION: lines 154-156 say 'assert' but only clamp. An inconsistent tokenizer declaring len=2 while emitting 5 distinct ids has raw entropy ratio 2.321928 and utilization 2.500000, yet BLME silently reports 1.000000 for both instead of failing closed; none of the 61 real-tokenizer runs triggered this path.

DOCUMENTATION: compression_ratio uses len(text), i.e. Unicode code points, not UTF-8 bytes. For the two-code-point string 'e-acute plus emoji' represented by 6 UTF-8 bytes and one emitted token, BLME reports 0.500000 tokens/code-point versus 0.166667 tokens/byte, a 3.0x distinction that must be named explicitly.

PROTOCOL/PROVENANCE: Rust et al. use UD/CoNLL token boundaries whereas BLME deliberately follows Ali et al.'s whitespace denominator. On 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.', BERT gives BLME 10/9 = 1.111111 but the UD-style punctuation-separated population gives 10/10 = 1.000000; the source-specific boundary choice must accompany reported fertility values.
fix: Keep the source-faithful fertility formula unchanged. Remove normalised_token_entropy from the normalized feature set (or rename it as a sample-ceiling descriptive) until a replacement survives both exact sample-replication and unused-vocabulary function-preserving tests and clears vocabulary, width, and depth association checks; the current 0.500000 to 0.150515 replication shift is disqualifying. Raise the effective configured corpus toward the 10000-document source protocol, pin its split/filter/order/digest, and publish convergence. Exclude vocab_size, vocab_utilization, and the exact duplicate rescalings from beyond-architecture structural features while retaining them as explicit controls. Replace max(1,total_words) with an NA/error guard, use itertools.islice before materialization, validate rather than clamp impossible fractions, and specify compression_ratio as tokens per Unicode code point (or deliberately switch it to UTF-8 bytes).
